author: KEXP
description: Surrealist blues poet and musician aja monetcenters her art around resistance, love and a quest for joy. In-studio with host Larry Mizell, Jr., she shares a performance of "hollyweird" and more from her forthcoming album 'the color of rain,' out May 22.
title: aja monet performs '"hollyweird" & more Live on KEXP
